# API Index

API contracts for the Vault API surface. API definitions are derived from the [Object Model (RFC-0025)](../rfcs/RFC-0025/README.md) and consumed by the [Developer SDK (RFC-0021)](../rfcs/RFC-0021/README.md).

## Surfaces

- Vault lifecycle (create/open/lock/unlock)
- Object CRUD & versioning
- Attachment streaming
- Search
- Backup / restore / recovery
